name: Padilla de Abajo (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a red cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Padilla de Abajo (frying pans on blue, crosses and a castle).
history: Municipal flag of Padilla de Abajo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Padilla de Abajo arms — frying pans, crosses and castle
